releaseNotes:
- Update check: AUTO_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MINUTES lets the interval go below an hour, which the hours-only knob could not express (7b5dfd0)
- Sidebar update button: a release is detected within ~30 minutes, and the status endpoint never blocks on the network (eea9e32)
- scripts/update-9router.sh: verifies the checksum, backs up the running binary, installs atomically, and refuses a binary that cannot execute (74f663f)
